Your attendance is below the 75% requirement [Doc: Examination & Attendance Rules 2026-27 §2] in the following course:

* **CS301 - Database Management Systems**: 66.9% [SQL]

**Can the shortfall be condoned?**
Yes, because your attendance is at least 65% but below 75% (66.9% ≥ 65%) [SQL], the shortfall may be condoned on medical or other documented grounds [Doc: Examination & Attendance Rules 2026-27 §3]. 

To apply for condonation, you must meet the following conditions:
* Submit a condonation application with supporting documents (e.g. a medical certificate) to the Head of Department [Doc: Examination & Attendance Rules 2026-27 §3].
* Pay a condonation fee of ₹500 [Doc: Examination & Attendance Rules 2026-27 §3].
* Request condonation before the last teaching day of the term [Doc: Examination & Attendance Rules 2026-27 §3].
* You may receive condonation in at most two courses per term [Doc: Examination & Attendance Rules 2026-27 §3].
sql: SELECT c.course_code, c.title, e.attendance_pct FROM (SELECT * FROM enrollments WHERE student_id = 'S2024CS006') AS e JOIN courses AS c ON e.course_id = c.course_id WHERE e.student_id = 'S2024CS006' AND e.status = 'enrolled' AND e.attendance_pct < 75.0 ORDER BY e.attendance_pct ASC LIMIT 200
